name: Pilbara Minerals Limited
content: Pilbara Minerals is a leading Australian lithium-focused mining company that owns and operates the world-class Pilgangoora Operation in Western Australia's Pilbara region. As one of the largest independent hard-rock lithium operations globally, it produces spodumene and tantalite concentrates. The company is a key player in the global electrification supply chain, providing essential raw materials for the lithium-ion battery industry. Pilbara Minerals is committed to sustainable growth through production expansion, downstream processing initiatives, and strategic partnerships to maximize value from its resource base.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Dale Henderson(Date: 2022 July)

Managing Director and CEO

Dale Henderson was appointed as Managing Director and CEO in July 2022, having previously served as the Company’s Chief Operating Officer since 2017. He is an experienced mining executive with a strong track record in operations, project development, and corporate leadership across various commodities including lithium, gold, and base metals.

Luke Bortoli(Date: 2023 April)

Chief Financial Officer

Luke Bortoli joined Pilbara Minerals as CFO in 2023. He was previously the CFO of Afterpay and has extensive experience in financial management, capital markets, and corporate strategy within high-growth environments.

Vince De Carolis(Date: 2022 November)

Chief Operating Officer

Vince De Carolis is the Chief Operating Officer, responsible for overseeing the Company's mining and processing operations. He has over 25 years of experience in the resources sector, including senior roles at BHP and Newcrest Mining.

Sandra McInnes(Date: 2022 July)

Chief Sustainability Officer

Sandra McInnes is the Chief Sustainability Officer, leading the Company's ESG strategy, health, safety, and community relations. She has extensive experience in corporate affairs and sustainability within the mining industry.

Paul Graves(Date: 2023 October)

Chief Commercial Officer

Paul Graves is the Chief Commercial Officer, overseeing sales, marketing, and business development. He has significant experience in the lithium industry and global supply chains.

Directors

Kathleen Conlon(Date: 2024 January)

Non-Executive Chair

Kathleen Conlon is a highly experienced non-executive director and former business executive. She was a partner at the Boston Consulting Group and currently serves on the boards of several major Australian companies.

Dale Henderson(Date: 2022 July)

Managing Director

Dale Henderson is the Managing Director and CEO of Pilbara Minerals. He has been instrumental in the development and operation of the Pilgangoora Project.

Nicholas Cernotta(Date: 2017 February)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Nicholas Cernotta is a mining engineer with over 35 years of experience in the resources industry. He has held senior executive roles at Fortescue Metals Group and Macmahon Holdings.

Steve Scudamore(Date: 2016 July)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Steve Scudamore is an experienced non-executive director with a background in chartered accounting. He was a partner at KPMG for 28 years and specializes in audit, risk management, and corporate governance.

Miriam Stanborough(Date: 2021 October)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Miriam Stanborough is a chemical engineer with over 20 years of experience in the minerals processing industry. She has held roles at Monadelphous, Iluka Resources, and Alcoa.
